method.filtering_summary: The live search pulled 2,614 postings; 1,834 were older than 7 days, 53 were reposts of listings over 30 days old, 301 were senior or excluded titles, 160 were not target roles, 157 failed Kenya eligibility, 13 were already applied to and 22 were duplicates. Of the closely reviewed roles, three micro1 Software Engineer contracts and Canonical's Python Container Images role were left off because they match roles he has already applied to or seen. Most Jobgether leads were Europe-only once the posting was opened. Wellfound was not checked (it needs the signed-in browser pass) and ReliefWeb failed with a parse error. Jobicy's dates look like bump dates, so its listings were rechecked at the source.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen for fast coding and agent work
stories.summary: Rolling out across the Gemini API, AI Studio and the Gemini app; priced at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens across a 1M-token context.
stories.why: A cheaper, fast model aimed at the agent workflows he builds.

stories.title: Salesforce open-sources SOV-Transcribe-1 speech model
stories.summary: Open-weight ASR model with 4 billion active parameters (26 billion total), released on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0.
stories.why: A self-hostable transcription option for voice-agent and automation projects.

stories.title: Perplexity releases Decider v1.3 classification models
stories.summary: Decider and Decider Flash v1.3 add exact text-span extraction and Apache-2.0 weights; Perplexity reports 91.6% mean accuracy across 63 query-classification tasks.
stories.why: Routing and classification models like this are building blocks for agent pipelines.

stories.title: Kindo raises $30M to manage enterprise AI agents
stories.summary: Crosspoint Capital and Forgepoint Capital co-led the round, bringing total funding to $57.6 million; revenue grew about 800% year over year in 2026.
stories.why: Agent governance is a growing hiring area next to his automation work.

stories.title: Rox raises $100M at a $1.3B valuation for sales AI agents
stories.summary: Series B co-led by General Catalyst and March Capital, part of a day that also saw Fractile raise $720 million.
stories.why: Well-funded agent startups are the ones likely to hire automation engineers.

stories.title: Axle raises $9M to add AI agents to investment-bank software
stories.summary: Eniac and Bonfire Ventures led the round; the money goes into AI agents for corporate-access teams.
stories.why: Another early-stage agent company building in finance, close to his fintech background.

stories.title: Huang's exit tests Nvidia's African AI bet
stories.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO; partner Cassava's rollout could cost up to $720 million for 12,000 GPUs, with Kenya part of the expansion plan.
stories.why: Local GPU capacity in Kenya would shape AI jobs and tools in Nairobi.

stories.title: Indeed: US tech job postings up from a year ago in Q3
stories.summary: Overall US postings rose 3.1% year over year to October 23; every tech category is up, led by software development, and software wage growth hit 2.9% in September.
stories.why: A modest recovery in tech hiring, though still below early-2020 levels.

stories.title: Airtel Money opens wallet-to-bank transfers via PesaLink
stories.summary: Through a partnership with IPSL, Airtel Money users can send money to accounts at 30 banks, Saccos and microfinance institutions.
stories.why: More interoperability in Kenyan payments, the space his fintech work touches.

stories.title: Treasury proposes seizing unclaimed crypto and stablecoins
stories.summary: Idle digital assets would join shares and bank accounts that the Unclaimed Financial Assets Authority can take over.
stories.why: Signals how Kenya plans to regulate digital assets held by fintech users.

stories.title: Kenya opens SecureKE sovereign security operations centre at Konza
stories.summary: KoTDA and Kenyan firm SecureKE set up the SOC about 65 km southeast of Nairobi to serve government and private organisations.
stories.why: New local security work and demand for engineers who can automate monitoring.
